item.title: Open Source License
item.description:
• XWOS Core Code
    • XWOS core code is released under MPL-2.0.
    • Scope: source code under the xwos and xwmd directories.
  • XWOS Peripheral Code
    • XWOS peripheral code is released under Apache-2.0.
    • Scope: source code under the xwcd, xwbd, xwam, xwbs, and xwxr directories.
  • Third-Party Software
    • Scope: source code under the xwem directory and third-party driver source code within xwbd.
    • Disclaimer: Third-party open-source software integrated into the XWOS project is provided for reference only. Users must independently audit these components for defects and verify their LICENSE terms, and assume all associated defect and legal risks. The XWOS development team disclaims all legal liability.
